title: Sales agent: recommended lead and opportunity actions in Microsoft 365 Copilot
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap facts and documented product controls are supported, and it keeps the unconfirmed Microsoft 365 experience separate from the Dynamics 365 background. The tenant access path should extend to Microsoft 365 Copilot to identify the application toggle.
